verdict.rationale: Skills carry YAML frontmatter, and agents load each skill's name and description to decide when it is relevant. A hands-on probe confirmed `skills add --list` shows every skill's name and full trigger description before install, so developers can preview what a skill does and when it fires. However, nothing shows that a description is mandatory or validated for every skill, and the skills.sh listing UI reportedly doesn't surface descriptions inline. missing for 10: evidence that a what/when description is required and enforced for every published skill, validation of description quality or trigger accuracy, descriptions surfaced directly in the skills.sh directory UI

support.subject: As a developer, every skill documents what it does and when it activates, so I can predict my agent's new behavior before it surprises me

citations.quote: enumerated all 9 skills in a public repo — each with its name and full trigger description — WITHOUT installing anything
At startup, agents load only the name and description of each available skill, just enough to know when it might be relevant.
The SKILL.md file must contain YAML frontmatter followed by Markdown content.
